title: I Tried Day Trading with No Experience
summary: First-hand test of day trading crypto with no experience and leverage; nearly every trade lost money and the fundraising goal was met by a sponsor, not trading.

assertions.quote: literally every single time I trade I lose money and every single time I don't trade I miss opportunities to make money
day trading is all about drawing lines yes over here over there and hoping the price will follow these lines for some reason
if you win it's huge and if you lose it's a huge problem
it was time for me to play aggressively and so I did it I started buying and selling buying and selling
this skill requires a bunch of time if you want to get good at it
